title: Make a microwaved egg and cheese muffin sandwich

steps.do: Spray the inside of the mug with cooking spray
steps.done_when: The inside of the mug is coated and the mug sits on the cutting board

steps.do: Crack {egg_count} into the bowl and discard the shell
steps.done_when: Raw egg is in the bowl and no shell remains in the bowl

steps.do: Place the bowl with the egg in the microwave and heat it with the door closed
steps.done_when: The bowl with the egg is inside the closed microwave

steps.do: Slice the English muffin into two halves on the cutting board
steps.done_when: The English muffin is separated into two halves laid flat on the cutting board

steps.do: Remove the egg from the microwave and stir it until the yolk is broken and mixed
steps.done_when: The egg in the bowl is uniformly mixed with no intact yolk visible

steps.do: Return the egg to the microwave and heat it for {microwave_time}
steps.done_when: The mug with the egg is inside the closed microwave with the display lit

steps.do: Remove the egg, pierce the yolk with the spoon, return it to the microwave, and heat it until set
steps.done_when: The egg is out of the open microwave in its cup and appears cooked rather than runny raw egg

steps.do: Add red sauce and seasoning to the cooked egg and stir the mixture
steps.done_when: Red sauce and seasoning are mixed into the egg in the bowl

steps.do: Spread sauce on a muffin half and sprinkle shredded cheese over the muffin halves
steps.done_when: Both muffin halves on the board are topped with sauce and shredded cheese

steps.do: Add shredded lettuce over the cheese on the muffin base
steps.done_when: Shredded lettuce covers the cheese on the muffin base on the cutting board

steps.do: Spoon the egg mixture onto the muffin base and place the top muffin half over it to close the sandwich
steps.done_when: A closed muffin sandwich sits on the board with the egg, cheese and lettuce enclosed between the two halves
